content.text:
Perfect! I found that:
- INFIRMIER (nurses) has code 24
- Bretagne has code 53

Now let me check the date format and query for February 2025:

input.sql:
SELECT 
  SUM(PRS_ACT_QTE) as total_quantity
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS
WHERE BEN_RES_REG = 53  -- Bretagne
  AND PSE_ACT_SNDS = 24  -- INFIRMIER (Nurses)
  AND FLX_ANN_MOI = 202502  -- February 2025
